helpIntro: UC San Diego uses a 4.0 UC GPA scale. Enter quarter units and final UC letter grades; A+ and A are 4.0, and plus/minus grades change points except A+.
helpNote: For undergraduate planning. P/NP, S/U, I, IP and W do not enter GPA. Courses from other UC campuses generally count, while most non-UC transfer and Extension grades do not. Repeat Impact is disabled because official repeat adjustments depend on the first 16 eligible repeated units and transcript-specific exceptions.
helpExample: A 4-unit A earns 16 grade points and a 4-unit B+ earns 13.2. Together, 29.2 ÷ 8 = 3.650.

gradeExplanations.A+: A+ = 4.0; no extra grade points beyond A.
gradeExplanations.F: F = 0 points; letter-graded units remain in the GPA denominator unless an official repeat adjustment removes the original attempt.
gradeExplanations.P: P earns degree units when applicable but is excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.NP: NP is excluded from GPA; repeat policy may affect a later cumulative adjustment.
gradeExplanations.I: Incomplete is excluded until resolved; a lapsed or final grade can later change the record.
gradeExplanations.IP: In Progress is excluded until a final grade is recorded.
gradeExplanations.X: X is a pending academic-dishonesty notation; use the final posted grade when resolved.

specialTypes.name: UC course (UCSD or another UC campus)
specialTypes.note: Use final UC letter grades and quarter units.

specialTypes.name: Non-UC transfer course
specialTypes.note: Most non-UC transfer grades do not enter the UC cumulative GPA, even when units transfer.

specialTypes.name: UC Extension / UCSD Extended Studies
specialTypes.note: Extension coursework is excluded from the UC GPA described by Academic Senate Regulation 500.

repeatPolicy.note: Repeat Impact is disabled. For an official cumulative GPA after a repeat, use the repeat codes on Academic History; do not simply delete every original D/F/NP.
